question.text: Shale gas discovery through horizontal drilling is an example of:

answer.text: A secular trend caused by technological advancement

explanation.text: The Logic: Per p.109, horizontal drilling technology enabled shale gas exploration as a secular trend driven by technological advancement, and per pp.110 and 112 this had long-term effects on value migration and crude/hydrocarbon prices. The Trap: Cyclical, seasonal, and temporary-anomaly classifications do not match the structural, technology-driven secular nature described in the workbook for the shale-gas case. Note: The "horizontal drilling enabled shale gas; secular technology-driven trend; long-term crude/hydrocarbon impact" framing is taken directly from pp.109, 110, and 112.
